questions.question_text: Reflect triangle T in the line x = -1. Label the image A.
Translate triangle T using the vector (1 / 4). Label the image B.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle V.
Stretch triangle V with factor 1/2 and invariant line x = 2. Label the image C.
Find f(3)
Find h(7)
Find the value of x when g(x) = -6.
Find f^(-1)(x).
Simplify f(x) * g(x) + 1.
Solve h(g(x)) = 0.
When x = 5, y = 1. Find y in terms of x.
Find y when x = 3.
Find the value of x when y = (x + 1).
Complete the scatter diagram. The first six points have been plotted for you.
Find the median time spent reading the news on Monday.
Find the equation of the line of regression. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.

On Tuesday, each person spends the same time listening to the news as they did on Monday. They each spend 5 minutes longer reading the news than they did on Monday. Write down the equation of the line of regression for Tuesday.
In February Sancho read the news for a total of 8 hours. This was a reduction of 36% from January. Work out how long Sancho read the news in January.
Calculate the mean number of articles read.
On the diagram sketch the lines y = -1/2 x + 3, 2y = x + 5 and y = x for -6 <= x <= 7.
Show, by shading, the region that satisfies these inequalities: y > -1/2 x + 3, 2y < x + 5, y > x.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x).
Write down the coordinates of the local maximum.
The equation (x - 2)^3 - 5x + 12 = k has exactly 2 solutions. Find the values of k.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x).
Solve f(x) = g(x).
Kayla walks from A to B on a bearing of 105°. She then walks back to A. Calculate the bearing Kayla walks from B to A.
It takes Kayla 24 minutes to walk from A to B. Calculate her average speed in km/h.
Kayla has a map with a scale of 1 : 25 000 showing A and B. Work out the length of AB on the map. Give your answer in centimetres.

A train is 770 m long. The train takes 2 minutes and 36 seconds to travel completely through a tunnel. Its speed through the tunnel is 120 km/h. Work out the length of the tunnel. Give your answer in metres.
Show that angle ABD = 77.0° correct to 1 decimal place.
Calculate the area of triangle ABD.
Calculate BC.
Calculate the length AC.
Calculate EM, the height of the pyramid.
F is the mid-point of BC. Find the angle between EF and the base of the pyramid.
Find the height of cone B.
A sphere also has volume 66 cm^3. Calculate the radius of the sphere.
Complete the tree diagram for the first and second discs.
Jani takes a third disc from the bag at random. Find the probability that he takes 2 black discs and 1 white disc.
Write down an expression for the number of green discs.
The probability of taking a red disc from the bag is 1/3. Show that 3x = 10 + y.
The probability of taking a green disc is 2/9. Write another equation in x and y and find the number of red discs and the number of blue discs.
Find angle PQR.
Find the obtuse angle BOD.
Show that the length of one side of the pentagon is 10.9 cm correct to 3 significant figures.
Calculate the shaded area.
Simplify fully (64x^6 y^3)^(2/3).
3^x * 2^x = 279936. Find the value of x.
Show that 4x^2 - 1 = 0.
Find the length of AB.
